SHA-256 digest in <i>releases.tfvars</i><br/>• Cryptographic image digests for containers<br/>• SHA-256 package hash for Lambda function zips<br/><br/><b>Single Release Candidate Policy</b><br/>• Exactly one RC promoted sequentially across tiers<br/>• Zero environment-specific artifact builds<br/>• Immutable deployment packages across dev, qa, pdn<br/><br/><b>Audit &amp; Traceability</b><br/>• Every release maps to exact commit hash<br/>• Traceable to roadmap issue and PR approval" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="390" x="610" y="245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Environment &amp; Workload</b><br/>• Primary production cloud workload (AWS)<br/>• Live coffee producer data (Cauca, Huila, Tolima)<br/><br/><b>Four Mandatory Production Gates</b><br/>1. CAB Approval: SR1 Human Lead sign-off<br/>2. Federation Notice: 24h advance notification<br/>3. Harvest Blackout: Blocked 05:00-18:00 COT<br/>4. Plan Review: Zero unexpected resource changes<br/><br/><b>Deployment &amp; Safeguards</b><br/>• Automated <i>terraform apply</i> on PR merge<br/>• CodeDeploy canary shift (D11)<br/>• CloudWatch style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Pipeline Identity & Remote State [D01, D02, D03]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="380" x="265" y="865" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>GitHub Actions OIDC Authentication</b><br/>• Short-lived credentials via <i>aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials</i><br/>• Zero static access keys or long-lived secrets in GitHub<br/><br/><b>IAM Roles &amp; Boundaries (ASM-171)</b><br/>• <i>github-actions-plan-role</i>: Scoped read-only plan permissions<br/>• <i>github-actions-apply-role</i>: Scoped write permissions for deployment<br/>• <i>github-actions-breakglass-role</i>: High-privilege role requiring SR1 approval<br/>• Bound by <i>pipeline-boundary-policy</i> to prevent privilege escalation<br/><br/><b>Remote State Isolation [D02]</b><br/>• Dedicated S3 bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn isolated)<br/>• DynamoDB state lock table prevents concurrent execution<br/>• State encrypted at rest with AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMK)<br/><br/><b>Secrets Management [D03]</b><br/>• Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store<br/>• Runtime dynamic resolution; zero credentials stored in Git" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="560" x="85" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="560" width="600" x="690" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_codedeploy" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#C925D1;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.codedeploy;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="710" y="860" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_lambda_b2" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="770" y="860" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Function Deployment Pattern [D11]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="440" x="830" y="865" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Deployment Engine &amp; Strategy (ASM-181)</b><br/>• AWS CodeDeploy application and deployment groups<br/>• Production strategy: <i>LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes</i><br/>• QA strategy: <i>LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes</i> (full simulation)<br/>• Dev strategy: <i>AllAtOnce</i> for rapid sandbox development iteration<br/><br/><b>Traffic Routing &amp; Validation</b><br/>• Shifts 10% of production traffic to the new Lambda version<br/>• Evaluates live traffic during the 5-minute canary window<br/>• Automatically shifts remaining 90% of traffic upon green alarms<br/><br/><b>Target Workloads [D06]</b><br/>• Telemetry Ingestion Processor Lambda<br/>• Drone Reception &amp; Screening Lambda<br/>• Agronomic Alert Dispatcher Lambda" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="560" x="710" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="560" width="600" x="1315" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_cw_b3" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;html=1;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.cloudwatch_2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1335" y="860" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Observability & Rollback Alarms [D13]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="500" x="1395" y="865" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>CloudWatch Rollback Alarms</b><br/>• Lambda Error Rate &gt; 1% during deployment window<br/>• P95 Latency &gt; 5000 ms threshold violation<br/>• Ingestion Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) message surge<br/><br/><b>Automated CodeDeploy Rollback</b><br/>• Automatic trip: CodeDeploy immediately reverses traffic to prior version<br/>• Zero manual intervention required to prevent customer impact<br/>• Retains prior stable version alive with zero downtime<br/><br/><b>Alert Notification &amp; Logging</b><br/>• Publishes deployment failure event to SNS alert topic<br/>• Emits structured CloudWatch logs with deployment ID and error trace<br/>• Dispatches high-priority alert to engineering team" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="560" x="1335" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_b4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="560" width="660" x="1940" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_b4" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Harvest Blackout & Forward Correction Policy" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="620" x="1960" y="865" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_b4" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=13;fontColor=#334155;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="<b>Coffee Harvest Deployment Blackout (ASM-183)</b><br/>• Blackout Window: 05:00 to 18:00 Colombia Time (COT)<br/>• Harvest Days: Active harvesting periods in Cauca, Huila, Tolima<br/>• Completion Rule: All production changes must conclude before 05:00 COT<br/>• Advance Notice: 24h prior notification sent to Federation<br/><br/><b>Emergency Incident Exception</b><br/>• Standard blackout can only be bypassed during active Sev-1 incidents<br/>• Requires formal tracking ID: <i>INC-YYYYMMDD-NN</i><br/>• Requires explicit authorization from SR1 Human Lead<br/><br/><b>Forward Correction Policy</b><br/>• All fixes roll forward through standard Git workflow and CI pipeline<br/>• No manual resource modifications in AWS console or live CLI<br/>• No <i>git revert</i> in production without full promotion sequence" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="620" x="1960" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

aroma-pacifico-terraform-modules
• Reusable core Terraform modules
• Enforces tflint, tfsec, checkov validation
• Published via semver tags (vX.Y.Z)
aroma-pacifico-infrastructure
• Environment root definitions (dev, qa, pdn)
• Remote backend configuration per environment
• Isolated network and state topologies
aroma-pacifico-platform
• Application services, Lambda functions, containers
• Pinned artifact references in releases.tfvars
• Automated lint and unit test suites on all PRs

div.div:
Deterministic Release Pinning (ASM-174)
• Pinned Git SHA-256 digest in releases.tfvars
• Cryptographic image digests for containers
• SHA-256 package hash for Lambda function zips
Single Release Candidate Policy
• Exactly one RC promoted sequentially across tiers
• Zero environment-specific artifact builds
• Immutable deployment packages across dev, qa, pdn
Audit & Traceability
• Every release maps to exact commit hash
• Traceable to roadmap issue and PR approval

Environment & Workload
• Primary production cloud workload (AWS)
• Live coffee producer data (Cauca, Huila, Tolima)
Four Mandatory Production Gates
1. CAB Approval: SR1 Human Lead sign-off
2. Federation Notice: 24h advance notification
3. Harvest Blackout: Blocked 05:00-18:00 COT
4. Plan Review: Zero unexpected resource changes
Deployment & Safeguards
• Automated terraform apply on PR merge
• CodeDeploy canary shift (D11)
• CloudWatch rollback alarms armed (D13)

div.div: Pipeline Identity & Remote State [D01, D02, D03]

div.div:
GitHub Actions OIDC Authentication
• Short-lived credentials via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials
• Zero static access keys or long-lived secrets in GitHub
IAM Roles & Boundaries (ASM-171)
• github-actions-plan-role: Scoped read-only plan permissions
• github-actions-apply-role: Scoped write permissions for deployment
• github-actions-breakglass-role: High-privilege role requiring SR1 approval
• Bound by pipeline-boundary-policy to prevent privilege escalation
Remote State Isolation [D02]
• Dedicated S3 bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn isolated)
• DynamoDB state lock table prevents concurrent execution
• State encrypted at rest with AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMK)
Secrets Management [D03]
• Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store
• Runtime dynamic resolution; zero credentials stored in Git

div.div:
Deployment Engine & Strategy (ASM-181)
• AWS CodeDeploy application and deployment groups
• Production strategy: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
• QA strategy: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes (full simulation)
• Dev strategy: AllAtOnce for rapid sandbox development iteration
Traffic Routing & Validation
• Shifts 10% of production traffic to the new Lambda version
• Evaluates live traffic during the 5-minute canary window
• Automatically shifts remaining 90% of traffic upon green alarms
Target Workloads [D06]
• Telemetry Ingestion Processor Lambda
• Drone Reception & Screening Lambda
• Agronomic Alert Dispatcher Lambda

div.div: Observability & Rollback Alarms [D13]

div.div:
CloudWatch Rollback Alarms
• Lambda Error Rate > 1% during deployment window
• P95 Latency > 5000 ms threshold violation
• Ingestion Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) message surge
Automated CodeDeploy Rollback
• Automatic trip: CodeDeploy immediately reverses traffic to prior version
• Zero manual intervention required to prevent customer impact
• Retains prior stable version alive with zero downtime
Alert Notification & Logging
• Publishes deployment failure event to SNS alert topic
• Emits structured CloudWatch logs with deployment ID and error trace
• Dispatches high-priority alert to engineering team

div.div: Harvest Blackout & Forward Correction Policy

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 618px; height: 1px; padding-top: 912px; margin-left: 1933px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;

div.div:
Coffee Harvest Deployment Blackout (ASM-183)
• Blackout Window: 05:00 to 18:00 Colombia Time (COT)
• Harvest Days: Active harvesting periods in Cauca, Huila, Tolima
• Completion Rule: All production changes must conclude before 05:00 COT
• Advance Notice: 24h prior notification sent to Federation
Emergency Incident Exception
• Standard blackout can only be bypassed during active Sev-1 incidents
• Requires formal tracking ID: INC-YYYYMMDD-NN
• Requires explicit authorization from SR1 Human Lead
Forward Correction Policy
• All fixes roll forward through standard Git workflow and CI pipeline
• No manual resource modifications in AWS console or live CLI
• No git revert in production without full promotion sequence
